info.title: PgQueryNarrative API
info.description: Postgres-native query intelligence: secure read-only SQL, EXPLAIN plan analysis, and optional AI narratives

get.description: List configured data connections (id and display name only)

post.description: Add a candidate rewrite and compare plans

get.description: Fetch a report by valid share token.

post.description: Revoke a share link so it can no longer be used to fetch its report.

get.description: Find reports semantically similar to input text

post.description: Natural language to SQL and report in one step: ask a question, get a generated SELECT, run it, and return the narrative report. Requires LLM.
